name: FLA_LEASE_ACTION_REQUESTS_ALL
description: FLA_LEASE_ACTION_REQUESTS_ALL contains the actions requests for the lease, used for reporting purposes.

columns.name: ACTION_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Unique lease action request identifier.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LEASE_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the actions which are applicable. Possible values could be Liability Analysis Report, Lease Transaction Report, Import, Expiry etc.

columns.name: LEASE_SUB_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the sub actions which are applicable. Possible values could be Review and Update.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: STAGE_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Request identifier of the staging request.

columns.name: ACTION_COMPLETION_DATE
columns.description: Indicates the date when the request action was completed.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Legal entity identifier for the lease contract.

columns.name: LEASE_ASSET_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether the lease asset is of Equipment or Property type.

columns.name: LEASE_CLASSIFICATION_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the classification of the lease version. Possible values are Finance lease, Operating lease or Exempt Lease.

columns.name: LESSOR_ID
columns.description: Party identifier which represents the lessor associated with the lease.

columns.name: LEASE_ID
columns.description: Lease identifier. It references the primary key of the FLA_LEASES_ALL table.

columns.name: LEASE_NUMBER
columns.description: Lease number of the lease which is selected.

columns.name: FROM_LEASE_NUMBER
columns.description: Lease number of the lease which is selected as From Lease Number.

columns.name: TO_LEASE_NUMBER
columns.description: Lease number of the lease which is selected as To Lease Number.

columns.name: FROM_LEASE_START_DATE
columns.description: Lease Start date which is selected as From Lease Start Date.

columns.name: TO_LEASE_START_DATE
columns.description: Lease Start date which is selected as To Lease Start Date.

columns.name: FROM_LEASE_END_DATE
columns.description: Lease End date which is selected as From Lease End Date.

columns.name: TO_LEASE_END_DATE
columns.description: Lease End date which is selected as To Lease End Date.

columns.name: VERSION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Version type code of the lease. Possible values are "D" for Draft version and "F" for Final version.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Period name of the accounting period.

columns.name: FROM_PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Period name of the accounting period selected as From Period Name.

columns.name: TO_PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Period name of the accounting period selected as To Period Name.

columns.name: VENDOR_ID
columns.description: Supplier identifier which represents the supplier associated with the lease.

columns.name: VENDOR_SITE_ID
columns.description: Supplier site identifier. It is used to send the information to Payables during the payment process.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Ledger identifier as defined in general ledger.

columns.name: BUSINESS_UNIT_NAME
columns.description: Denotes the translated name for the Organization Unit.

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_NAME
columns.description: Name of the legal entity that belongs to your own corporate structure (enterprise).

columns.name: LEDGER_NAME
columns.description: User entered unique ledger name.

columns.name: LESSOR_NAME
columns.description: Name of the lessor party on the lease.

columns.name: VENDOR_NAME
columns.description: Name of the supplier party on the lease payment.

columns.name: VENDOR_SITE_CODE
columns.description: Site code name of the supplier site.

columns.name: REGIME_CODE
columns.description: Regime code. This drives the accounting model and reporting for the lease.

columns.name: PERIOD_START_DATE
columns.description: Start date of the accounting period.

columns.name: PERIOD_END_DATE
columns.description: End date of the accounting period.

columns.name: FISCAL_QUARTER_START_DATE
columns.description: Start date of the fiscal quarter as defined in calendar.

columns.name: FISCAL_QUARTER_END_DATE
columns.description: End date of the fiscal quarter as defined in calendar.

columns.name: FISCAL_YEAR_START_DATE
columns.description: Start date of the fiscal year as defined in calendar.

columns.name: FISCAL_YEAR_END_DATE
columns.description: End date of the fiscal year as defined in calendar.

columns.name: FROM_PERIOD_START_DATE
columns.description: Start date of the accounting period which is selected.

columns.name: FROM_PERIOD_END_DATE
columns.description: End date of the accounting period which is selected.

columns.name: TO_PERIOD_START_DATE
columns.description: Start date of the accounting period which is selected.

columns.name: TO_PERIOD_END_DATE
columns.description: End date of the accounting period which is selected.

columns.name: FUNCTIONAL_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code as defined for the ledger.

columns.name: FUNCTIONAL_CURRENCY_PRECISION
columns.description: Currency precision as defined in the currencies precision for the functional currency.
